items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: He worked with Mike Shanawal, and he stayed here. And we worked on Canal Street with Joe Paz on piano at a supper club.

ctx.x: No, Walter Brown had already made his hits, Confessing the Blues and so forth. Yeah. And Walter Brown, well, let's say, did we have, I don't remember whether we had a session with Walter Brown or not. But anyway, the only one thing I could remember about Walter Brown, we played the Paradise Theatre in Detroit. Mm-hmm. And Walter Brown run up a big bill at the hotel, Gotham Hotel. And he wanted Mike Shan to pay the bill, it was more than his salary. And it seemed like Walter Brown must have had a habit of doing…
Yes. Is he any kid to Blues Bailey? That was Blues Bailey.

Oh, that's the same guy. We called him Blues Scott Short Light Skin Fella. Yeah, that's the same one. He worked with Mike Shanawal, and he stayed here. And we worked on Canal Street with Joe Paz on piano at a supper club. And hardly anybody come in, but this was for another gangster here. So I understand he was supposed to be serving 99 years in a pen that was doing. Earl Long was governor then. And he was in his club every night.
